ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Труд/труды» (trud/trudy, 'labor/labors') and «пользоваться» (pol'zovat'sya, 'to use, make use of') are kept as the repeated key words; the proverb «Люди век людям помогают» (lyudi vek lyudyam pomogayut, 'people help people all their lives') keeps its doubled 'people'. «Непризнание христианства» (nepriznanie khristianstva) is 'nonrecognition of Christianity', and «брат-человек» (brat-chelovek) is 'brother man'.
